en.name: Vortox
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.

zh.name: 涡流
zh.ability:
每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。
镇民玩家的能力都会产生错误信息。
如果白天没人被处决，邪恶阵营获胜。
